scope: Verify shared responsive Inspector styles on legacy captioned images and versionless spacers through Canvas, draft Save and explicit Publish; correct renderer fallback precedence defects.

initial_regressions.before_fix: Inspector and Canvas showed margin-top 16px; draft Save preserved the public 0px baseline; explicit Publish still produced public margin-top 0px because the renderer appended margin:0 after shared styles.
Inspector and Canvas showed height 40px; draft Save preserved the public baseline; explicit Publish remained 60px because the renderer appended min-height:60px after shared styles.

fixes.change: Captioned image margin/max-width defaults and uncaptioned image media defaults now precede shared responsive Inspector CSS so explicit node styles take precedence.

The versionless Spacer's 60px placeholder minimum is emitted only when resolved styles have no explicit height, min-height, max-height or aspect-ratio. Explicit Inspector sizing remains authoritative while untouched legacy spacers retain their fallback appearance.
